name: @nexgen-os/mqtt
description: The readings of P1 dongles received from an MQTT broker as the series of the meters they read: a P1M5 message or a DSMR telegram, the meter found by the dongle's identifier, dated in its participant's time zone, thinned and handed in batches to the caller that writes them (the core's measuredObjects()). Any MQTT client fits; no broker library is shipped.
